name: Oren Farhi
title: Principal / Staff Frontend Engineer · UI Architect
summary: Principal-level frontend engineer and UI architect with 20+ years of experience turning complex product requirements into scalable, maintainable software. I work across architecture, hands-on implementation, developer experience, testing infrastructure, and technical leadership - with deep expertise in TypeScript, React, modern frontend systems, and end-to-end quality. I am most effective in ambiguous environments where a team needs someone who can see the system, make pragmatic architectural decisions, write the hard parts, raise engineering standards, and mentor other engineers. I increasingly use AI-assisted development as an engineering force multiplier while keeping architecture, correctness, security, and maintainability firmly human-led. I am also the author of Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX and the creator of open-source JavaScript tooling used across the ecosystem.
